race.comment: ADORA DJON'S (12) was close to a maiden win before a three month break, finishing off with a placing over 1200m at Doomben. Has trialled well leading into this. Draws favourably in gate three and can make a winning return. EMPHATIQUE (7) just missed the frame in town last time out and will be rock-hard fit for this. Looms as the main danger. STAR OF ASCOT (1) closed last prep with a disappointing eighth over 1400m at Gold Coast. Back for a new campaign with a change of rider. Will appreciate the drop in grade and is sure to be thereabouts with the claim at odds. OUR COMBINATION (8) resumes but showed some ability in her first campaign. May feature while fresh.
